final_text:
Root cause: opening tags were normalized with `Style.normalize`, but explicit closing tags were compared using their raw spelling. This made case and style-order differences fail to match.

Changed `rich/markup.py` to normalize explicit closing tag names before matching them against the open-tag stack. Unmatched styles still raise `MarkupError`.
